results.title: Iran Releases Footage of Missile, Drone Launches, Claims Strikes on US Bases in Jordan

Tehran (HRNW)- Iranian authorities have released video footage purportedly showing missiles and drones being launched at US military bases in Jordan, including King Hussein and Al-Azraq.
